module_summary: Reservoir flow controller: a 6-state Moore FSM tracks water level and trend from three sensor inputs, decoding each state into nominal and supplemental valve outputs.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Water-level/trend state register; drives next-state and valve decode.

anchors.name: fr
anchors.why: State-decoded 4-bit valve vector driving fr2, fr1, fr0, dfr.

anchors.name: dfr
anchors.why: Supplemental flow valve, asserted when level previously rose.

groups.name: level_fsm
groups.description: Sensor-driven level and trend state machine.

groups.name: valve_decode
groups.description: Moore output decode of state into valve control outputs.
